name: Bandsintown
automation_notes: Direct WebFetch of city page and /robots.txt returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked); do not bypass. Public API (rest.bandsintown.com/artists/{artist}/events?app_id=) is restricted: per help.artists.bandsintown.com it is for artists/people working on their behalf, app_id tied to one artist; outsiders may email a request with traffic projections; student/educational use not accepted; data not to be used otherwise without Bandsintown approval (corp.bandsintown.com/terms-artists). Treat as no usable API for a third-party radar.
